messages:
alex_product: Quick async pulse — we're doing a compact milestone tally for the quarter. Please drop one short line per milestone you own: status (shipped/slipped), owner, blocker(s) if any, next step and ETA. I'll compile a short rollup by EOD.

alex_product: Format example -> runtime-v2-routing: shipped, dani_eng, no blockers, close follow-up: post-rollout perf dashboard (ETA 3/18).

dani_eng: runtime-v2-routing: shipped, dani_eng, observed ~5% p99 bump on long tails after canary, mitigation in-progress (tweaks to batching heuristics). next: patch rollout + perf job (ETA 3/20). cc @sam_infra for infra metrics spike.

sam_infra: noted, I'll keep an eye on autoscale alerts and increase margin on nodes during patch. also queued infra job to add a short-lived trace sampler.

mike_pm: embeddings-cache-layer: slipped, mike_pm, dependency: external hashing lib upgrade blocked by license check, next: legal signoff or swap to internal impl (ETA 3/25). will prioritize swap if legal delayed.

lina_qe: embed-cache: I can start regression tests against the swap in staging, need PR link + data scaffolding. pinging for CR.

mike_pm: PR coming in ~1hr: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1987 (draft).

terry_design: onboarding-flow-microsite: shipped, terry_design, no blockers, next: analytics funnel dashboard (ETA 3/22).

alex_product: model-rollout-canary (gpt-ish-variant): partial ship, dani_eng + research, blocker: eval regression on rare prompts (precision drop in slot-filling), next step: roll back canary on traffic >5% until eval passes (ETA investigation 3/19).

lina_qe: I'll add the failing prompt set to the regression suite and run nightly. if we get a clear signal we'll open a hotfix PR.

sam_infra: FYI, if we rollback canary, routing policy will fall back to model-e-legacy, latency will be slightly better. I've updated fallback policy to be automatic on error-rate >2%.

alex_product: ops note: who will own customer comms if we delay rollout? @mike_pm?

mike_pm: yes, I'll draft a short message for the top 10 customers and slip note for status page.

alex_product: CI/code review quick checks: - dani, your perf patch needs 1 reviewer and a green e2e. - mike, tag @lina_qe on the PR once ready. - terry, nothing needed from eng for the funnel dashboard besides the event names doc.

dani_eng: pinging @sam_infra for one review, also left a small TODO in the PR for a metric rename.

sam_infra: reviewing now, will do a quick perf sanity pass and mark for merge if green.

lina_qe: test infra note: please ensure staging contains the partial canary traffic pattern (50/50 split) otherwise regression won't reproduce. I can help with traffic shaping config.

alex_product: Dependencies summary for rollup: - legal for hashing lib (mike) - perf patch rollout monitoring (dani + sam) - eval regression triage (dani + research) - customer comms (mike) - QE test update & traffic shaping (lina).

alex_product: Action owners: dani (runtime perf), mike (embeddings & comms), lina (QE), sam (infra routing & autoscale), terry (design analytics). I'll send a short follow-up with these assigned and due dates.

deploy-bot: deploy-status: runtime-v2-patch -> canary deployed at 1854126000, 2/4 nodes. No errors reported.

dani_eng: thanks, pushing a tiny perf tweak to canary branch now (will update when deployed).

mike_pm: scheduling a 15m sync tomorrow 09:30 for anyone who prefers quick verbal triage. otherwise we'll continue async. :clock9: \n
alex_product: perfect — if you update this thread with ETA changes I'll fold them into the EOD rollup. thx all. :thumbsup:
